q: 嵌入向量在系统设计里的核心含义是什么？
q_en: What does an embedding mean in system design?
options: 把所有类别转成独立的 one-hot 维度
只用于压缩图片文件体积
把实体编码成可比较的稠密数值向量
把数据库表整体序列化成 JSON

why_en: An embedding is a dense numeric vector that captures an entity's meaning so similar entities end up close together.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Entity[Entity] --> Encoder[Encoder]
  Encoder --> Vec[Dense vector]
  Vec --> Compare[Similarity]
  Compare --> Use[Retrieve or rank]
options_en: Turn every category into its own one-hot dimension.
Compress image files only.
Encode an entity into a dense, comparable numeric vector.
Serialize a whole database table into JSON.
optionMeanings: one-hot：给每个类别分配独立、稀疏的维度。
把 embedding 误当成图片专用的压缩手段。
embedding 是稠密向量，相似实体距离更近。
把结构化数据直接转文本，不是向量表示。
optionScenarioImpacts: 误信会让新实体永远缺少共享结构。
会漏掉 embedding 在推荐、搜索里的用法。
支持相似度计算、检索和聚类。
序列化结果无法直接做向量相似度比较。
optionDirectness: 只做离散类别标识时可用，但学不到共享相似性。
图片压缩是另一个问题，不适合解释推荐或搜索向量。
需要相似度、检索或聚类时，这就是 embedding 的用途。
序列化适合传输或存储，不产出可比较的向量。
optionMeanings_en: One-hot assigns each category its own sparse dimension.
This mistakes embedding for an image-only compression trick.
An embedding is dense and places similar entities close together.
This directly turns structured data into text, not a vector.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Believing this leaves new entities with no shared structure.
It misses how embeddings power recommendation and search.
It supports similarity search, retrieval, and clustering.
Serialized output cannot be compared with vector similarity.
optionDirectness_en: Use one-hot for simple category IDs, but it will not learn shared similarity.
Image compression is a different problem, not the retrieval or ranking use case.
Use embeddings when you need similarity, retrieval, clustering, or ranking.
Serialization helps storage or transfer, but it does not create comparable vectors.

q: one-hot 与 embedding 在共享结构上的核心区别是？
q_en: What is the key structural difference between one-hot and embeddings?
options: one-hot 和 embedding 都能共享行为结构
one-hot 每维孤立，embedding 学到可迁移共享结构
one-hot 维度低，embedding 维度反而更高
新用户下两者都必须新增一个维度
why: 决定性维度是共享结构：one-hot 每维独立，新实体要开新维；embedding 学到共享表示，相似实体自然靠近。
why_en: Embeddings beat one-hot because they learn shared, transferable structure instead of one isolated dimension per entity.
tradeoff: 稀疏独立维度 vs 稠密共享结构
options_en: Both one-hot and embeddings naturally share behavioral structure.
One-hot dimensions are isolated, while embeddings learn transferable shared structure.
One-hot has lower dimensionality than embeddings.
Both require adding a new dimension for every new user.
optionMeanings: 误以为 one-hot 也有共享统计结构。
one-hot 每维只代表一个实体，embedding 让相似实体共用参数。

误以为 embedding 也要为新实体开新维度。
optionScenarioImpacts: 低估 one-hot 的冷启动和稀疏问题。
解释了为何相似用户能被泛化和迁移。
会让人误判存储和计算成本方向。
会漏掉 embedding 对新实体推理的优势。
optionDirectness: 如果只要唯一 ID，one-hot 可用；这里要共享行为结构。
需要相似用户泛化时，低维共享表示更合适。
维度成本分析时要反过来：one-hot 才随实体数膨胀。
新实体要复用同一向量空间，而不是继续加维度。
optionMeanings_en: This wrongly assumes one-hot also shares statistical structure.
One-hot isolates each entity; embeddings let similar entities share parameters.
This reverses reality: one-hot is the high-dimensional sparse side.
This wrongly assumes embeddings also need a new dimension per user.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It underestimates one-hot's cold-start and sparsity problems.
It explains why similar users generalize and transfer.
It misleads storage and compute cost judgments.
It misses how embeddings handle new entities without retraining.
optionDirectness_en: One-hot is fine for a unique ID, but not for shared behavioral structure.
Dense shared vectors fit when you need generalization across similar users.
For dimension cost, the direction is reversed: one-hot grows with entity count.
New entities should reuse the same vector space, not add new dimensions.

scenario: 你在设计视频推荐召回，需要解释“相似”到底由什么决定。

q: 解释向量相似度时最该强调什么？
q_en: When explaining vector similarity, what should you emphasize first?
options: 相似度永远等于标题关键词是否重合
相似度只由向量维度数量决定
相似度由数据库主键顺序决定
相似度由训练目标定义，不等于人类语义相似
why: 决定性是训练信号：共看、共买等目标各自定义不同的“相似”。面试先讲目标，再讲向量本身。
why_en: Similarity in an embedding space comes from the training objective, not from the word 'embedding' itself.
whenOtherWins: 如果任务是精确 ID 查找或权限校验，向量相似度不是核心，主键或规则会赢。
tradeoff: 训练目标定义的相似 vs 人类直觉的语义相似
options_en: Similarity always equals overlapping title keywords.
Similarity is decided only by the number of vector dimensions.
Similarity follows the database primary-key order.
Similarity is defined by the training objective, not by human semantic meaning.

把相似度归因到向量长度这个超参数。
把相似度和存储顺序混为一谈。
共看、共买、点赞等训练信号定义了相似。
optionScenarioImpacts: 会漏掉视频内容和行为的深层关联。
换维度不会改变训练学到的结构。
主键顺序和召回质量无关。
能解释为何两个内容不同的视频也会靠近。
optionDirectness: 关键词召回可作弱基线，但不能定义行为相似。
调维度能改容量和成本，不能单独决定相似含义。
主键只适合精确查找，不适合语义或行为召回。
回答推荐相似度时，应先说训练目标定义了邻近关系。

For recommendation similarity, start with the training objective.

q: 矩阵分解把用户-物品交互矩阵近似成什么？
q_en: What does matrix factorization approximate a user-item matrix as?
options: 用户矩阵 U 与物品矩阵 V 的低秩乘积
每个用户单独训练一棵决策树
所有点击行为的倒排索引
只保留热门物品的固定队列
why: 决定性是低秩约束：U·Vᵀ 近似稀疏交互矩阵 R，逼模型共享用户/物品的行为模式。
why_en: Matrix factorization approximates the sparse interaction matrix as a low-rank product of a user matrix and an item matrix.
options_en: A low-rank product of a user matrix U and an item matrix V.
A separate decision tree trained for every user.
An inverted index over every click event.
A fixed queue containing only popular items.
optionMeanings: 把稀疏矩阵压缩成两个低秩矩阵的乘积。
决策树按用户建模，不产出共享向量。
倒排索引按查询词组织，不是矩阵分解。
热门队列没有低秩向量结构。
optionScenarioImpacts: 低秩约束逼出用户和物品的共享行为模式。
每用户一棵树，规模上不可行也不共享结构。
倒排索引服务的是关键词检索，不是推荐向量。
固定队列无法个性化，也没有向量可用。
optionDirectness: 讲矩阵分解公式时，应落到 U 和 V 的低秩乘积。
按规则树预测单个用户时才像决策树问题。
关键词检索用倒排索引，推荐矩阵分解不是这条路。
热门队列可做兜底流量，不能学习个性化向量。
optionMeanings_en: It compresses a sparse matrix into the product of two low-rank matrices.
A decision tree is modeled per user and produces no shared vector.
An inverted index is organized by query term, not by factorization.
A popularity queue has no low-rank vector structure.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The low-rank constraint forces shared behavior patterns.
One tree per user does not scale and shares no structure.
Inverted indexes serve keyword search, not recommendation vectors.
A fixed queue cannot personalize and yields no vectors.
optionDirectness_en: When explaining factorization, name the low-rank product of U and V.
Decision trees fit per-feature prediction, not shared vector factorization.
Inverted indexes fit keyword retrieval, not recommendation factorization.
A popular-item queue can be a fallback, but it learns no personalized vectors.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: An inverted index maps each term to the list of documents containing it, used for keyword search.

q: 补全矩阵分解的典型形状。
q_en: Fill in the typical shape of matrix factorization.
text: 若 R 是 users × items，矩阵分解学习 U: users × {{k}} 和 V: items × {{k}}，使 U·Vᵀ 近似 {{R}}。
why: k 通常远小于用户数和物品数，逼模型压缩出共享的行为模式。
why_en: The rank k is far smaller than the number of users or items, forcing the model to compress shared behavior patterns.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分解出的向量维度，通常远小于用户数或物品数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: k is the embedding rank, the vector dimension used in the factorization, usually far smaller than the number of users or items.

q: 召回 baseline 最合适的起点是？
q_en: What is the best starting baseline for retrieval?
options: 从零训练大型多模态 Transformer

whenOtherWins: 如果有丰富文本/图像/序列信号且质量要求更高，两塔或序列模型会更有上限。
tradeoff: 便宜可解释的基线 vs 更高质量但更贵的表示

Learn vectors via matrix factorization, then retrieve with nearest-neighbor search.

关键词匹配理解不了语义相似。
矩阵分解便宜成熟，直接从交互矩阵学向量。
手写规则不随数据规模增长而扩展。

q: 两塔模型为什么适合大规模召回？

options: 它每次请求精排全量候选

It only fits small-scale datasets.

scenario_en: A search system needs semantic retrieval: live queries vary constantly, while the document corpus is large and changes slowly.
q: 应优先用哪种 embedding serving 方式？

options: 每次请求重新编码全部文档
只用 SQL LIKE 做全表扫描
把所有可能查询提前枚举好
文档离线编码入索引，查询在线编码
why: 决定性是文档库大且更新慢、查询侧多变，离线编码文档、在线只编码查询是语义召回的标准结构。
why_en: For semantic retrieval, stable documents should be embedded offline while only the query is embedded online.
whenOtherWins: 如果语料只有几百条、延迟不敏感，直接交叉编码全量候选可能更简单且质量更高。
tradeoff: 文档离线预计算 vs 查询在线实时编码
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Docs[Documents] --> Offline[Offline embed]
  Offline --> Index[ANN index]
  Query[Live query] --> Online[Online embed]
  Online --> Index
  Index --> Results[Retrieved docs]
options_en: Re-encode every document on each request.
Use a SQL LIKE full-table scan only.
Pre-enumerate every possible query in advance.
Embed documents offline into an index, and embed the query online.

关键词全表扫描没有语义理解。
查询千变万化，无法穷举。
文档侧稳定可预计算，查询侧必须实时。

同义词、语义相关查询会被漏掉。
